title: Manifest - Paintings
description: This pack will add a resource pack that includes some paintings of the Turkish girl music band "Manifest" . It will include some of the singers that are in the group.
body:
## ![Paintings - Tablolar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe7d09ded9d1c0908967608aaba0276f9ea273e6.png) 
Bring the heavy aesthetic and energy of the Turkish band, Manifest straight into your Minecraft world! 🎧

 We created a custom resource pack that replaces the default, boring vanilla Minecraft paintings with high-quality artwork, album covers, and iconic visuals of the Manifest members. If you are a fan of the band and want to design the ultimate music studio, a dark aesthetic base, or just rep your favorite artists in-game, this pack is exactly what you need.
